ModMetaData.name: RimWorldLLM
ModMetaData.author: Charleszard
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists talk, in their own voices. RimWorldLLM gives every pawn a mind and a way of speaking: speech bubbles over their heads, real back-and-forth conversations, private diaries, a colony chronicle, and inner thoughts that show what they want but don't say. Lines come from what is actually happening: injuries, deaths, raids, mental breaks, weddings, funerals, grudges and gossip. The tone matches RimWorld's own.
2.1.0 beta. Tested on Linux with NVIDIA cards. Windows and macOS builds are included but not yet tested; reports are welcome.
Runs on your own computer - Free. No API key, no account, no subscription. - Everything stays on your machine. Nothing about your colony is sent anywhere.
One click to set up On first start the mod offers to set up a local model. Click "Set up": it checks your graphics card and memory, picks a model that fits, and downloads it. Your colonists start talking on a small starter model within a few minutes, while the full model finishes downloading; the mod then switches over by itself and deletes the starter.
What is downloaded - One AI model from Hugging Face, sized to your card (see below): 3.1 to 10.0 GB. - llama.cpp, the program that runs the model, from its official GitHub releases. For NVIDIA cards (CUDA) that is about 0.8 GB to download and 2 GB on disk; for AMD/Intel (Vulkan) or a Mac, under 0.1 GB. - uv and Python 3.12 for the mod's helper program: about 0.2 GB on disk. Disk space with an NVIDIA card: about 12 GB in all on a 16 GB card once setup is done (about 16 GB at the peak, while the starter and the full model are both on disk), about 6 GB with E4B RP.
Where it lives and how to remove it - Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyEngine - Linux: ~/.local/share/easy-engine - macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/EasyEngine The helper's memory and log are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\rimworldllm-agent on Windows and ~/.local/share/rimworldllm-agent elsewhere. To remove everything: Mod settings, RimWorldLLM, Storage, Remove downloaded files (it also offers to delete the helper's memory and logs), then unsubscribe or delete the mod. Or quit RimWorld and delete those two folders by hand.
Hardware - 16 GB graphics card: Gemma 4 26B RP, the full experience (uses about 12 GB). - 12 GB card: the 26B with part of it in system memory (slower), or E4B RP. - 6 to 12 GB card, laptops, Apple Silicon: Gemma 4 E4B RP (uses about 5 GB). Good speech, simpler inner thoughts. - Very small cards or no card: stock Gemma 4 E2B. It works, but speech is simpler and repeats more; the mod tells you when it is in use. You can change the model any time, or use a GGUF file you already have: Options, Mod settings, RimWorldLLM, Model.
Already run your own model server? Choose "My own endpoint" in the mod settings and point it at any OpenAI-compatible server. Nothing is downloaded.
Content - Adult content is off by default. Turning it on asks you to confirm. - A hard age gate is always on: nothing romantic or sexual for or about any pawn under 18, in either mode.
Compatibility - Requires Harmony. - Does not need RimTalk and is meant to run alongside it. - Other mods can add context through a small hook API (see the GitHub page).
Source code (MIT license) - Mod: https://github.com/CharlesMod/RimWorldLLM - Engine: https://github.com/CharlesMod/easyEngine The downloaded models carry their own terms (Apache 2.0 with the Gemma terms of use); llama.cpp and uv have their own licenses.
